name: GiftsToPrint
original_description:
GiftsToPrint makes personalised newspaper-style posters for birthdays, wedding anniversaries, dating anniversaries and retirements. Each poster is a front page filled with real headlines, prices and events from the year that matters, personalised with the recipient's name, a photo and a message.

Posters come in four country editions (US, UK, Canada and Australia), so the news matches where the recipient grew up. Over 4,000 verified reviews since 2021.

How it works in ChatGPT:
1. Tell ChatGPT who the poster is for and the occasion. It finds the right poster and shows the price in your currency.
2. It asks for the details the poster needs (names, dates, an optional message) and your photo.
3. It reads everything back to you, then gives you a link to GiftsToPrint's own checkout with every detail already filled in. You review and pay there. Nothing is charged inside ChatGPT.

Important: this is a digital product. You receive a high-resolution JPG print file by email, usually the next working day (12-hour and weekend rush options are available). You print it at home or at any print shop. Nothing is posted.
